raw_text: Water rising fast near Metro Pillar 42, Mayur Vihar Phase 1. Three people are stuck inside a ground-floor shop.
Serious flooding beside Pillar 42. Water is almost waist deep and entering the shops. Rescue help needed.
I am at Metro Pillar 42. Two elderly residents cannot cross the flooded lane and the current is getting stronger.
Mayur Vihar Phase 1 metro side road is flooded badly. Autos have stopped and water is above the footpath.
Water has entered three shops near the Pillar 42 market lane. One shopkeeper says people are still trapped inside.
Flood current near Mayur Vihar metro station is pulling parked bikes. Police barricade required urgently.
Pillar 42 wali gali mein chest-level water at the lowest point. Residents are shouting for ropes and life jackets.
Confirmed from the Mayur Vihar Phase 1 metro market: rapid waterlogging, power supply still on in a few flooded shops.
The small bridge near Sector 4 has partially collapsed after floodwater hit the side wall. Do not use this route.
Road access across the Sector 4 bridge is blocked. Debris and a damaged railing are covering one lane.
Standing near the Sector 4 crossing. A section of the bridge approach has given way and one scooter is stuck in debris.
Sector 4 bridge route completely jammed. Concrete pieces have fallen near the eastern end; emergency vehicles cannot pass.
Just turned back from the bridge near Sector 4. Looks unsafe and police are asking everyone to take the service road.
Fresh crack visible on the Sector 4 bridge approach. Water is flowing under the broken edge and the road surface is sinking.
RWA volunteers have blocked entry to the Sector 4 bridge because part of the approach road has collapsed. Please use another route.
Near Mayur Vihar metro, floodwater has reached parked car doors. Saw residents moving upstairs with medicines and documents.
Sector 4 bridge has collapsed on one side. I can see broken concrete and the approach lane is no longer passable.
The Sector 4 bridge is fine, it has NOT collapsed. The road is only waterlogged and traffic is being diverted as a precaution.
